runtime: macOS native Objective-C test harness; production manager, audio and extracted production hook bodies; deterministic fake task budget and clock
coverage: finite task execution without background audio
adaptive checks and one pending timer
26 second task replacement, acquire-before-release and failed-replacement latch
audio handoff below 10 seconds and minimum playback duration
15 second recovery threshold, three separated observations and notification burst resistance
DBL_MAX, NaN, negative, infinity and huge finite remaining-time values
low-budget cleanup, task expiry and late timer/expiry callbacks
foreground, settings, multiple scenes and capability notifications
native audio ownership, interruptions, media service resets and startup failures
synchronous expiration/foreground during native activation and settings changes during state notifications
limitations: These tests verify software state and ownership behavior. They do not establish real iOS background lifetime or energy savings.
